MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 46
   C. 120
   D. 30

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

3. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

4. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

5. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 19
   C. 88
   D. 38

6. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 29
   C. 23.6
   D. 23.7

7. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

8. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

9. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 18
   C. 36
   D. 7

10. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

11. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

12. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
